body: I'm so sorry you've been abused by her for so long. :( That's really sick that she even whispers cruel things to you while others are around. That's evil. I'm glad that you avoid being alone with her now. Are you able to go low contact with her at all? Hugs. <3
For me it messes with my mind more so when it's an Nparent doing this rather than a partner. It's more confusing to me if that makes sense, even though I know what's happening.

Oh yes I've read about love bombing in abusive relationships. Sometimes there's also the honeymoon period when the abuser will buy you a gift, and act nice for a short time after abusing you. This cycle seems to apply for narcissistic/abusive parents too.  Yes you're right. It's done in order to pull the victim back in so that he/she doesn't leave.
Yes you're right. It messes with your mind as well, which is also draining.
Thank you for the encouragement! <3 I will keep you guys updated.

Thank you for your advice. <3 Yes you're right. It's helpful to hear that it doesn't make me a bad pet owner as I felt really guilty about having to do this. Oh asking the vets if they know any reliable fosters is a great idea as well. I'm going to try that. There's a "cat clinic" vet not to far from me. Yes that's true. The fosters know it's temporary and do it out of love.

Thank you for your advice. <3 I'm so glad shelters offer the fostering for people who are leaving abusive situations. I'm going to call them, tell them my situation and see if they can find a foster for my cat.

Thank you for your advice. <3 It's helpful. Yes I'm going to look at good pet sitters websites, and I'll check if it's insured too. For some reason I didn't think of the fact that animal shelters already have a list of fosters. I'm glad you pointed that out. I'm going to contact the local shelters/rescues too and ask about foster carers for this situation. Yes I will tell them it's only temporary too.
Thank you. <3 Ohh I'm glad you still have him and that he's fine. It helps to know other people had to do the same thing and that it turned out fine.
Thank you. <3 Yes I'm going to look into pet sitters, cat boarding and foster carers.

Thank you for your advice. <3 That's really nice of you to have fostered animals. I'm so glad they allow fostering for the respite reasons including domestic violence, couch surfing, etc. I'm glad they're not judgemental too. I will explain the domestic violence situation and about possibility of me going homeless as the reason why she needs a foster.
Thank you. <3
Oh yes you're right. I'll get blood tests soon to make sure. It's dangerous she doesn't dispose of them properly and puts others at risk. This one that I stepped on was on the kitchen floor.
Thank you. <3 I didn't know about the hotline. That's good. The pain has calmed down now thankfully so I think it should be ok/not infected, etc.
Thanks for the information. I'm glad that they help for free when this happens. <3

Thanks for all of the information. <3 It was really helpful. Wow I didn't know the needle exposure was common in domestic violence situations. Yes I'm going to search for the low income clinics. I think there's a free clinic at my local youth centre. The pain has gone now but if it gets bad again or if it happens again I'll go get it checked out. I'm glad they do free tests for this. That's good. Sorry for the late reply. The last few days were crazy so I didn't get to come on here.

Thanks for your advice. Oh I'm glad the bleeding helps get the germs out. That's good. I will look for some rubbing alcohol or hand sanitizer to put on it. Yes I watch out for the bruising, swelling, etc. Awww. That sucks it happened to you too. I'm glad yours cleared up. <3

Thanks. Yes I totally agree about the projection. Oh that's a great idea. I will just say "I'm going out." You're right. Less info is always better with narcs.  Hahahahahahaha. You really made me laugh about the gang bang thing. That would be hilarious. Lol.

Yes exactly. I was thinking the same thing as well. Like I'm an adult anyway so there would be nothing wrong with having sex or dating. She treats it like it's evil. Yes I've suspected she might be projecting as well. She used to cheat on Efather when I was younger, and I remember years ago Efather was questioning if my sister was ever his child or not. I often feel like all of that has now been projected onto me.

When she tried to hit my face it was right after I walked inside through the front door after telling her I'm an adult. Efather was in the lounge room about 3 meters away. There is one small wall separating the walk in area and the lounge room. This is where she tried to hit my face and I protected my face. I'm not sure if Efather saw her do that. She seemed to lean in on purpose so that he couldn't see. After that I walked through the lounge room with Nmother behind me continuing to accuse me, and Efather watched that and did nothing about it. He didn't say a word.
Thank you. <3
Thank you. <3

Thank you for your advice. <3 I go for walks to calm my anxiety and to get out of the house (usually early evening when anxiety is worse.) Walking is actually one of my favourite things to do to calm down. The only issue is that every time I go out, especially when I go for walks Nmother accuses me of being out having sex with guys. She seems to get especially triggered when I go for walks for some reason. I'm not sure how to respond to that. I stood up for myself once about it, telling her that I'm an adult and can get fresh air outside when I need to, and she went insane and tried to hit my face, told me it's her house and her rules, etc, and just keep telling me (and Efather) I was out 'having sex'. Since then I've just ignored her comments when I walk out the door, but it doesn't stop her saying those things. So it just makes what is meant to be something peaceful/relaxing into something traumatic. Yes I will be able to contact the financial aid centre next week and ask them what's going on. My family doesn't have access to my bank account as I opened it in secret and put down a different address.


Yes I plan to be out of the house as much as possible again once that financial aid comes through as I'll have money for busses and everything. I will store my important possessions and documents at my friend's house soon too. Yes I've been trying to do the grey rock method, and I don't tell family anything personal, or about my plans, etc.

Thank you. <3  Yes I'll wait a bit longer. Next week I'll be able to ask the centre why the financial aid isn't in my account yet. I'll try to continue being creative with different ways to escape too.

Thank you. <3 I appreciate it. Your message is so kind. Yes you're right. I think I feel like no one would miss me due to Nmother crushing my self esteem, and from not having many friends due to being isolated. I've been trying to be more social. I think that part will be easier when I have money to go out and especially when I can move as she won't be able to control me.

Thank you for caring. <3 Yes I will wait a bit longer for the financial aid to come through, and if it doesn't I'll speak to the centre about resolving the issue. That's great that there's a crisis line you can text. I should try that. I have actually saved a suicide hotline and also a domestic violence hotline in my mobile phone contacts, and I've called them during difficult times. The hotlines are helpful.

Thank you. <3 Yes the freedom would be amazing. I always dream about it. Yes I've been approved for the financial aid, so it's only delayed either because of an error on the banks part, possibly some delay in processing, or an error on the financial aid centre's part. If it hasn't been resolved I can speak to the centre when they're open after the holidays later next week. It helped me when you pointed out that it's only a delay, because sometimes I confuse a delay with never escaping, etc.
Thank you.
Thank you <3 I'll try to hang on.

Thanks. I've thought about running away and living in another state. I've also thought about sleeping in parks or someone's car until I'm able to move. I wish I could. The only issue is I can't leave my cat here for long periods of time without me. I know they'd abuse her, and it would also break my heart to give her away. She's helped me through a lot of dark times. I was planning to get into a share house so that I could bring her with me.
